programme.title: Wo Jiao Zhang Si De
programme.desc: Set during the Chinese Communist Revolution, this historical drama follows the life of Zhang Side, a humble peasant from Sichuan who joined the Red Army. Rather than portraying him as an oversized hero, the series focuses on his quiet work ethic and selflessnessfrom surviving the Long March to serving as a guard in Yanan. In 1944, Zhang tragically dies when a charcoal kiln collapses, sacrificing his life to save a fellow soldier and leaving behind an enduring legacy of selfless service

programme.title: Jue Mi Shi Ming
programme.desc: In the early 1930s, the Communist Party established a top-secret underground route connecting Shanghai, Hong Kong, Shantou, and Fujian to their main base in Ruijin to bypass severe military blockades. Together, they smuggled vital intelligence, essential supplies, and safely escorted key leadersincluding Zhou Enlaiacross enemy lines

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: All Suspects ((全员嫌疑人))
programme.desc: A policeman on leave checks into a BB, sharing the space with a detective novelist, a homeless drifter and a pianist. However, when the owner and the receptionist are found dead, the peaceful retreat turns into a web of suspicion and deceit. Each guest becomes both suspect and sleutheach guarding a secret that could unravel the entire mystery. (休假的警察检查了BB,与侦探小说家、无家可归的流浪者和钢琴家共享空间。 但是,当发现主人和接待员死亡时,和平撤退就变成了猜疑和欺骗的网络。 每一位客人都成为嫌疑犯,并隐匿着可能揭开整个谜团的秘密。)

programme.title: Guilt By Design ((催眠·裁决))
programme.desc: On the final day of a shocking murder trial in Hong Kong, a renowned hypnotherapist serving as a juror receives a video showing his daughter being kidnapped. The abductors demand that he hypnotize the jury to manipulate the final verdict. Torn between justice and family, he must decide how far he is willing to go to save her. (在香港令人震惊的谋杀案审判的最后一天,一位著名的催眠疗法医生担任陪审员,他收到一段录像,显示他的女儿被绑架。 绑架者要求他催眠陪审团,以操纵最终判决。 在司法和家庭之间,他必须决定他愿意如何拯救她。)

programme.title: Love Lies ((血爱成河))
programme.desc: Gynaecologist Veronica downloads a dating app for fun. Little does she know that the charming French engineer on the other end is actually a local con artist named Joe, who is a member of an online scam group. As their fake relationship unfolds, both Joes guilty conscience and Veronicas hopes intensify. (维罗妮卡(Veronica)的妇科医生下载了约会应用软件来取乐。她不知道另一端迷人的法国工程师其实是一个名叫Joe的本地骗子。 Joe是网络骗局集团的成员。 随着他们假关系的发展,Joes的内疚和Veronicas都希望加强。)

programme.title: Moscow Mission ((警察学校7：进军莫斯科))
programme.desc: The story is based on a 1993 true event, the China-Russia Train Robbery where a gang of criminals commits a heist, stealing cash and goods from the cross border train. A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman heads the operation to arrest the criminals, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead (故事的根据是1993年发生的一次真实事件,即中俄火车抢劫,一帮罪犯抢劫一帮罪犯抢劫,从跨境火车上偷盗现金和货物。 中国一名警察伪装成商人,领导逮捕罪犯的行动,但发现了更大的阴谋。)

programme.title: Royal Tramp ((鹿鼎记))
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find The Sutra of 42 Chapters. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps. (魏晓宝是一个革命团体派来 在皇宫内做间谍 并找到42个分会的天皇)

programme.title: A Legend ((征服世界盃：梅西的傳奇之路))
programme.desc: Archaeologist Professor Fang uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream. To unveil the truth, Professor Fang leads his team to a journey into the glacier, embarking on a fantastical adventure together. (考古学家方教授在一次冰川探险中发现了一些文物,这些文物与他的梦中一颗玉冠相似。 为了揭示真相,方教授带领他的团队前往冰川,一起踏上了一场奇妙的冒险。)

programme.title: Mad Fate ((命案))
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tungs mad fate? (一位总算算算师预测,天生的精神病患者董东将因谋杀而入狱,并试图改变他的命运。 一位经验丰富的侦探认为,在目睹通目睹他杀死一只猫并无情地追杀他之后,他就是精神病连环杀手。 大师能改变通斯的疯狂命运吗?)

programme.title: The Last Tycoon ((最后的大亨))
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war. (黑帮手陈达升上了权力的上层阶层,但发现自己被两名女性的爱情,秘密服务的谋杀阴谋和迫在眉的战争威胁之间撕裂.)

programme.title: I Want to be Rich ((做个有钱人))
programme.desc: Young Wah rises from a poverty-stricken background, carrying the heavy burden of caring for his gambling-addicted parents and younger siblings. Against all odds, his resilience and determination to provide a better life for his family eventually lead him to achieve significant success in real estatea testament that perseverance pays off. (年轻的华人从贫困背景中崛起,背负着照顾其赌博父母和年幼的兄弟姐妹的沉重负担。 面对种种困难,他为家人提供更好生活的韧力和决心最终使他在房地产方面取得巨大成功,证明坚持不懈的精神是值得的。)

programme.title: Wu Kong ((悟空传))
programme.desc: Set 500 years before the Monkey King Wu Kong wreaks havoc in the heavenly kingdom, the movie tells the story of how Wu Kong who, unwilling to bow to his own destiny, sets out to rebel against the gods. (在五百年前, 猴王吴港在天国大浩劫, 电影讲述了吴港 不愿屈从于自己的命运, 如何反抗神灵的故事。)

programme.title: Welcome to My Side ((欢迎来到我身边))
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways. (陈小周在痛苦的分手和奇特的事故后,被一群只有他能看见的摇摇晃晃晃的橡皮鸭缠住了。 每当他和欢乐的冯佳南在一起时,他的怪咒就会消失。 随着他们的亲近,一个荒谬而又令人心动的浪漫花花,以出乎意料的方式改变了他们的生活。)

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts ((七擒七纵七色狼))
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddys career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation (泰迪曾经是一位著名的电影明星,但现在却面临着职业衰落。为了谋生,他接受五个门徒将他们塑造成星星。泰迪与长期失踪的女儿团聚后,其职业生涯恢复了势头,但他同时也遇到对手。他的女儿和门徒决定帮助他克服困境。)

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant ((摇篮凡世))
programme.desc: In a conservative society, a baby hatch that never closes sparks fierce moral controversy and public backlash. Despite mounting criticism and pressure, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie and Nuru remain steadfast in their mission to protect desperate mothers with nowhere else to turn, while offering abandoned newborns a fragile chance at life and hope. (在一个保守的社会中,一个从未关闭的婴儿孵化场引发激烈的道德争议和公众反弹。 尽管批评和压力越来越大,莱苏、法蒂玛、卡姆杰和努鲁仍然坚定地履行保护绝望母亲的使命,没有别的地方可去,同时为被遗弃的新生儿提供脆弱的生活和希望机会。)

programme.title: The Phantom Lover ((夜半歌声))
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from Tos father and bitter jealousy from her designated fianc, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community. (1926年,中国有才华的歌手宋英俊深爱着来自富裕家庭的可爱的无辜女孩托,他们的爱激起了托斯父亲的强烈反对,也引起了她指定的未婚夫的强烈嫉妒,未婚夫是她家庭所选择的一位年轻男子。 这是一个关于一名歌手和一个富人女子在传统社区中争吵在一起的故事。)

programme.title: Little Red Sweet ((红豆))
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united? (由于母亲遭受了严重的中风,在科隆市的长家族拥有的中国甜点店面临了动荡.他们的女儿牺牲了成为空姐的梦想,以帮助维持家庭业务,但随着她和父亲的冲突,紧张局势日益升高.)

programme.title: Stuntman ((特技替身演员))
programme.desc: Washed-up stunt director Li Sen is offered the role of action choreographer on his director friends final film. Bringing along an ambitious young stuntman, the two generations risk everything to stage a comeback. As Li Sen battles his fierce temper and past mistakes, he also strives to mend his relationship with his estranged daughter. (李森被弃的作导演在导演朋友的最后电影中被提供作战舞蹈演员的角色.带着雄心勃勃的年轻作员,两代冒着一切的风险来舞台上回归. 李森正与他的激烈气质和过去的错误作斗争,他也努力修复与他疏远的女儿的关系.)

programme.title: Dead Talents Society ((诡才之道))
programme.desc: Newbie ghost Rookie must fight to prove herself in the afterlife, where spirits are required to deliver spectacular scares to earn their place. Facing the threat of vanishing if she fails to secure a haunting license, she teams up with a washed-up ghost diva and her spectral agent, who train her to become the next star and stage the worlds greatest fright. (Newbie 幽灵Rookie必须战斗以证明自己在来世,在后世,灵魂必须提供壮观的吓唬以赢得他们的位置。 面对如果她不能获得一个漫无目的的许可证而消失的威胁,她与一个被冲洗的幽灵Diva和她的光谱特工联手,后者训练她成为下一个明星并给世界带来最可怕的情景。)

programme.title: Its A Wonderful Life ((好运到))
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all. (香港巨头任达库安照顾了他的四代家庭,然而他的三个儿子都面临着自己的挑战.他的女儿回到法国和她的朋友罗伯托一起学习时,一切都发生了变化.罗伯托为任家带来了一波转型,为所有人带来了新的希望和机会.)

programme.title: The Exodus ((苍穹之法芙娜 EXODUS))
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men. (一个低级警察发现了一群妇女,包括他的上司方方女士和妻子,密谋消灭男人的世界。)

programme.title: Golden Boy ((金童))
programme.desc: After a decade in prison, former boxer Cheung Lek meets his son for the first time. Forced to live together for an inheritance, the estranged pair struggles to rebuild trust. As Cheung Lek returns to the ring for one last shot at redemption, he must confront his past and fight for a future with his son. (在监狱服刑十年后,前拳击手张立首次见到儿子。 被迫共同生活是为了继承遗产,这是为重建信任而争斗的一对纷争。 当张乐返回拳击场争取救赎的最后一击时,他必须面对过去,与儿子为未来而斗争。)

programme.title: Band Four (第四乐队)
programme.desc: An aspiring singer of an indie band called Band Four reunites with her estranged guitarist father following the death of her mother. Together with her half-sister and her nine-year-old son, the newly reunited family come together to support each other through their love and passion for music. (在她母亲去世后,一个叫Band Four的独立乐队的一位有抱负的歌手与她离散的吉他手父亲团聚。 与其同父异母的姐姐和9岁的儿子一起,新团聚的家庭聚集在一起,通过对音乐的爱和热情相互支持。)

programme.title: Table for Six 2 ((还是觉得你最好2))
programme.desc: The sequel to Table for Six, Bernard and Lung plan to get married while their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for everyone involved. (布纳德和在婚礼期间结婚,但婚礼却变成了混乱的战场,家庭剧情不断升级,为所有参与者造成混乱的事件.)

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix ((女巡按))
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the familys young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huos stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover! (在黄梅歌剧传统中,这部电影讲述了温,他卖自己为一个富裕家庭的奴隶,和 Huo,家庭的小女儿的爱情故事. 情人被胡斯的继母隔离, Huo逃脱着穿身为男人. 温被入了监狱,所以 Huo不得不回去拯救她的情人!)

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger ((错点鸳鸯))
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriends baby... (与女朋友分手后,售货员Bao遇见了一个富家女金镇,她刚与男友分手。 两个同样心碎的陌生人立刻坠入爱河,并因冲动而结婚。这对夫妻幸福地生活在一起,直到金金金发现自己怀着前男友的婴儿。)

programme.title: The Jade Raksha ((玉罗刹))
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind (一位叫杰德·拉卡沙的可怕的剑剑女出现在武术世界中,开始杀害姓燕的人。一位剑士知道她是谁,问她为什么。显然,18年前,一个燕子杀了她的家人,她只有报复心智。)

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again ((乌龙济公))
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins. (活佛吉骨和不朽的Lu Dong Bin沉浸在凡人世界中,数名妇女的命运引发了一场争斗。 当这两个神灵在三次奇特的竞赛中展示其力量时,一系列可笑的不幸事件发生了。 在浪漫纠缠中,不朽者和人类之间开始了一场史诗般的战斗。)

programme.title: Young Vagabond ((少年苏乞儿))
programme.desc: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master are slain by the ruthless bandit, Centipede, Su Can embarks on a perilous quest for revenge. (苏卡(Su Can)是一位酒主的无忧无虑而又不诚实的长子,在被开除出学校后被迫由教师指导学习。 他很快就发现他的老师是武术大师,成为他的门徒。 然而,当他的家人和主人被无情的土匪(Centipede, Su Can)杀害时,他的家人和主人开始危险地寻求报复。)

programme.title: Lovers Blades ((神经大侠))
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed. (将把一对不可战胜的武器 " 刀锋 " 交给清皇,但意外落入小中惠和元光南之手,于是皇上卓天雄就把他们捉拿下来,在战斗开始时,刀剑的秘密也暴露出来。)

programme.title: Swift Sword ((情侠追风剑))
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan. (一个正义的剑客白义邦(Bai Yi Pang)向一个邪恶的部族复仇,但在被他们殴打后残废。 数年后,一个年轻人遇见了藏在洞穴里的白白。 白白决定教这个坚定的年轻人他的斯威夫特剑术,以便帮助白白报复邪恶的部族。)

programme.title: The Kingdom And The Beauty ((江山美人))
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved... (成德皇帝在访问中国南部时遇见了国女李峰,一见钟情,皇帝在离开时承诺李峰会成为他的压抑品。当他一年后派去李峰时,她病得无法忍受艰难的旅程,及时抵达,无法在心爱的怀中死去。)

programme.title: The Golden Seal ((金海豹))
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his fathers death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge. (吴晓燕从小就练武术,为父亲的死报仇。 他遇到了一天伪装成男子的吴晓燕,突然被一群黑帮殴打。 吴恳求她父亲让她带戴雄回家康复。 戴小丹不知道这是他报仇的机会。)

programme.title: Human Lanterns ((人皮灯笼))
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Longs wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident (7年后,龙赵龙在决斗中被龙龙击败,龙龙求赵王代表他做个独特的灯笼,以赢得灯笼比赛,而赵王则计划报复。 当长妻突然消失,听到人灯的故事,长妻可能卷入其中。)

programme.title: The Young Avenger ((小毒龙))
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brothers death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu? (刘晓华想为兄弟们的死报仇,在战斗中失去一只手臂,十年后发誓复仇。李明华要求姐姐送女儿宝珠去学龙剑之术,为他报仇。 保珠成长成为一名熟练的武士,与刘晓华的表弟陈氏相遇,计划进行决斗。 她能打败刘晓珠吗?)

programme.title: River of Tears (眼的河)
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husbands death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living... (退休歌手和丈夫和儿子生活得很快乐.悲剧发生在她过去的一个男人回来追捕她时.在随后的斗争中,为了摆脱她的手,她的丈夫在车祸中死亡.被她的岳父指责为丈夫的死亡,被赶出房子,回到歌唱中以谋生.)

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2 ((倚天屠龙记大结局))
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuans original hit. (唯有将强大的天剑和强大的龙剑 联合起来 才能拯救六大武术宗派 争取至高无上)

programme.title: The Happiest Moment ((一乐也))
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barbers apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy. (这场色情喜剧的Anthlogic有三个故事:一个老人死于过量的病毒药丸;一个警察在向妓女勒索钱财后逃命;一个理发师学徒在夜间守夜时遇到活死人。 通过扮演所有这些角色,迈克尔·辉秀证明了自己是香港喜剧的天才。)

programme.title: Asia-pol ((午夜亚洲：美食·舞蹈·梦想))
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eatons location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies. (亚洲刑警组织特工杨明春追踪一批走私黄金运给黑帮头目乔治·伊顿。他寻求一位中国妇女的帮助,她正试图为妹妹报仇,在关闭伊顿时,他躲过了几个致命的陷阱。这部间谍电影受到詹姆斯·邦德电影的启发。)

programme.title: Gang Master ((帮规))
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history. (这是一则关于军队要摧毁元龙反元革命分子的反元龙帮的故事。 他们的领袖鲁易图(Ru Yi Tu)与新龙帮的后继者富忠元对抗,后者必须证明自己的合法性。 阴谋充满了谋杀、争斗和令人震惊的发现,它们可能改变历史进程。)

programme.title: Heroes of the East ((笕桥英烈传))
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge! (一位中国男子通过包办婚姻与一位日本妇女结婚,并设法侮辱她所有的日本武术家庭,向她提出了被其他人误解的挑战。 然后,他必须证明,通过与七位日本武术艺术家进行一系列决斗,来迎接挑战,中国功夫到底有多棒!)

programme.title: The 82 Tenants ((82家房客))
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy House of 72 tenants, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood? (继续经典喜剧"72人房"的成功,这部续集讲述了香港老建筑住户被开发商迫驱逐的故事.一些租户更喜欢接受补偿,而一些则反对此举.收购计划将破坏邻居的和吗?)

programme.title: Come Drink with Me ((大醉侠))
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman Golden Swallow is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar Drunken Cat who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kongs entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards. (神秘剑术女皇金燕女的弟弟被绑架了。她与一位乞丐德伦肯·卡特(Drunken Cat)联手,他擅长武术,将兄弟从腐败的修道院中解放出来。 这部电影被选为香港第39届学院奖最佳外语电影参赛者。)

programme.title: Les Belles ((完美的骗子))
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure. (作为香港最伟大的音乐剧之一, 作为最佳女演员的Linda Lin主演的这部豪华电影,)

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters ((龙虎少爷))
programme.desc: An elite fortune hunter and a reckless young heir team up to search for a legendary pirate treasure. Their quest leads them to a remote monastery, where they must outwit a formidable Shaolin monk. However, when ruthless bandits close in, the unlikely allies must put aside their differences and fight side by side to survive. (一个精英的财富猎手和一个鲁莽的年轻继承人团队去寻找一个传奇的海盗宝藏。 他们的追求引领他们来到一个遥远的修道院,在那里他们必须战胜一个强大的少林和尚。 然而,当无情的土匪靠近时,不可能的盟友必须抛开分歧并肩作战以生存。)

programme.title: The Purple Shell ((紫贝壳))
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Huis husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end? (Hui和Ha被困在他们不愉快的婚姻中,当他们在聚会上见面时互相吸引。在他们的一个海滩漫步中,Ha拿起一个紫色的贝壳,把它交给Hui作为纪念物。当Hui的丈夫发现这些壳壳时,他伤害了Hui,让她病得很重,同时也敲诈Ha。这个爱情故事会如何结束呢?)

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis ((血海螳螂仇))
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tians rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tians granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death. (冯皇帝命令冯皇帝在他家寻找天主造反的证据。 冯王爱上天斯孙女并娶她。 当他找到证据并试图与她离开时,他的妻子在与天王的战斗中丧生。 冯王创造了象一样的武术,并誓言为她的死报仇。)

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess ((万花迎春))
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance. (贝蒂在一个舞蹈团中担任主角舞蹈家,并申请成为一位富有的女孩贝蒂的司机.当传言说他是她的情人时,贝蒂生气,并作为一名报道员来调查谣言.他们在这个过程中恋爱,经过许多测试后,他们最终用舞蹈封闭了他们的爱情.)

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu ((黄飞鸿义取丁财炮))
programme.desc: As Shen and Wong Fei Hungs relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhous favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission? (沈和飞关系变得酸,沈将和他的门徒谋杀.他们被商人周救了,但必须赢得狮子舞奖,以回报周的好处.飞能击败所有熟练的武术艺术家并完成他的任务吗?)

programme.desc: After a CM is charged with corruption, he is forced to pass the baton to his son. He with no political experience, finds himself stuck to the chair.

programme.desc: Nana, a powerful gangster, vies for control of a village. However, Kathar, an honest man, strives for peace, resulting in a clash between the two.

programme.desc: A young mans dream to do good deeds for the upliftment of his village is interrupted by an influential man, who does not want anyone to grow above him.

programme.title: Dd Next Level

programme.desc: Vikram, A Pragmatic Policeman, And His Partner Simon Are On The Hunt To Capture Vedha. When Vedha Voluntarily Surrenders, He Offers To Tell Vikram A Story, Throwing Vikrams Life Into Disarray.

programme.title: J Baby
programme.desc: Sakthi lives with her six-year-old daughter Adhithi after getting separated from her husband. Things become worse when Adhithi starts hearing voices and gets attached to a ghostly figure.

programme.title: Kingston
programme.desc: In 1982, a curse falls on Thoovathors sea. Kingston, a brave smuggler, and his friends sail into the haunted waters. Their mission: break the curse and save their village.

programme.title: Zambia Untamed ((狂野赞比亚))

programme.title: 디어 마이 프렌즈
programme.desc: 끝나지 않았다, 살아있다. 황혼기 청춘들의 인생찬가. 어른과 노인의 차이가 대체 뭘까? 이 질문은 이 드라마의 출발점이었다. 본 드라마를 위해, 우리는 청춘들의 어른에 대한 시각을 취재했다. 그들은 가차없이 자신의 윗세대를 어른 아닌 다만 노인으로 폄하하며, 몇몇 부정적 단어로 그들을 규정지었다. 꼰대, 불편, 의무, 부담, 뻔뻔, 외면, 생색, 초라, 구질, 원망, 답답 등등. 사회적 관계에서 만나는 어른은 그렇다 쳐도 부모 조차도 가차 없었다. 말은 완곡했으나 조용히 살아주셨으면 은 공통된 견해였다. 우리는 이런 부정적 시선이 어디서 기인했나 고민했다. 청춘의 인색함일까? 역지사지 못하는 무지일까? 다만 싸가지가 없어서 일까? 우리는 청춘들의 이러한 시각이 어른들에 대한 정보의 부재, 관찰의 부재에서 온 것이라 결론지었다. 어른들이 청춘의 아픔에 갖는 무지 역시 같은 이유일 것이다. 그도 그럴 것이, 드라마 속과 언론 속 시니어는, 참으로 재수 없지 않은가. 돈에 목메고, 남의 자식 상관없고 내 자식에만 목메고, 기존의 질서에 목메고 변화를 두려워하며, 결코 사회적 문제를 약자의 편에서 사고치 않으며사회복지를 노인복지로 국한 지어 규정하는, 사유치 않으며, 젊은이를 경쟁상대로 여기거나 방해하며, 자기만 옳다고 주장하면서 나이로 권력으로 생색내는 자, 끝없이 훈계만을 늘어놓는 지혜 없는 다만 늙은 자. 본 드라마에서 우리는 노인의 이야기가 아닌 어른의 이야기를 하려 한다. 그래서, 제목처럼 청춘과 어른이 친애하는 친구가 되는 관계가 되길 바라는 마음이다.

programme.desc: 최고의 특수 요원들이 미 해군과 해병대에 관련된 모든 범죄를 수사하는 과정을 흥미진진하게 담은 범죄 수사물. 지난 시즌7부터 시즌8까지 매회 전미 시청률 1위를 기록하며 폭발적인 인기를 얻고 있는 작품이다. 특히 이번에 방송되는 시즌8은 미국에서도 지난 9월말 첫방송을 시작, 현지에서 인기리에 방송중인 최신작으로, 국내 시청자들도 미국 시청자들과 큰 격차없이 안방극장에서 만나볼 수 있다고. 진지한 범죄 수사과정 속에서 독특하고 개성 넘치는 캐릭터들의 유머 코드가 결합해, 색다른 범죄수사물로 자리잡으며 시청자들의 뜨거운 관심을 받고 있다.

programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: 짱구는 못말려 10
programme.desc: 조금은 건방지고 장난을 좋아하는 5살 유치원생 신짱구가 주인공으로, 부모님은 물론 주위의 어른들이 짱구가 일으키는 장난들에 휘말리고 마는 일상을 재미있게 그린 코믹 애니메이션. 투니버스에선 2001년 첫 방영을 시작하였으며, 현재까지도 시청자들에게 가장 큰 사랑을 받고 있는 작품 중 하나이다. 특히, 이번 lt짱구는못말려10gt은 짱구 출판 20주년, 방송 10주년을 기념하여 방영되는 시즌으로, 국내에선 한 번도 공개되지 않은 새로운 시즌이 방영될 예정이다.

programme.title: 신비아파트 고스트볼 X의 탄생
programme.desc: 지하국대적을 물리친 이후 하리와 두리는 꼬마 도깨비 신비와 함께 평화로운 나날을 보낸다. 그러던 어느 날, 신비아파트가 흑마법의 저주에 걸렸다는 것을 알게 되는데... 저주로 인해 더 강력해진 귀신들과 업그레이드된 고스트볼로 맞서 싸우는 하리! 그리고 알 수 없는 힘 때문에 괴로워하는 강림과 하리 앞에 새롭게 나타난 신비로운 소년 리온까지! 진짜 귀신은 지금부터다! 한 차원 더 업그레이드된 일상 속 공포! 더 무섭고, 더 강력해진 모습으로 신비아파트가 돌아왔다!

programme.title: Mattino cinque news
programme.desc: Storico programma mattutino di informazione e intrattenimento nel quale gli ospiti in studio discutono e approfondiscono diverse tematiche, scelte dai conduttori tra gli argomenti di maggiori attualit.

programme.title: Ore 11
programme.desc: Il nuovo programma incentrato sullattualit e sulla cronaca, condotto da Milo Infante.

programme.title: Dentro la notizia
programme.desc: Pomeridiano dinformazione con fatti di attualit, cronaca, documenti inediti e testimonianze.

programme.title: Tg5 Prima pagina
programme.desc: Le principali notizie del momento a cura della redazione giornalistica di Canale 5. Aggiornamenti riguardanti politica, cronaca, esteri, economia, sport e attualit.

programme.desc: Edizione del notiziario televisivo a cura della redazione giornalistica di Canale 5. Dal 13 Gennaio 1992, ogni giorno, le notizie pi importanti a livello nazionale ed internazionale.

programme.title: Superkaraoke
programme.desc: Da Piazza Trento e Trieste a Ferrara, persone comuni cantano e coinvolgono il pubblico. Con la conduzione di Michelle Hunziker, grandi artisti affiancano gli amatori. Scopriamo insieme le esibizioni.

programme.title: Compromessi sposi
programme.desc: Una fashion blogger di Gaeta, figlia di un politico improvvisato, e un cantautore bergamasco di famiglia leghista, entrambi ventenni, si innamorano e decidono di sposarsi. I parenti cercano di impedire le nozze.

programme.title: I luoghi di Magnifica Italia

programme.title: Un gioco mortale

programme.title: Animali Meccanici

programme.title: 4 di sera
programme.desc: Uno spazio informativo in cui discutere degli avvenimenti che segnano lagenda quotidiana, con gli aggiornamenti e le notizie pi importanti in materia di cronaca, politica, cultura, societ e sport.

programme.title: Forum
programme.desc: Il processo tv che affronta vicende comuni e quotidiane con uno sguardo sempre attento ai temi pi attuali. Spazio anche per il confronto dedicato alle cause pi complesse, in un dialogo tra generazioni diverse.

programme.title: 人體內的怪物第8季:4
programme.desc: 人體內的怪物第8季:寶寶的怪病.本集透過病人或親屬口述介紹三種怪病史蒂芬強森症候群是一種罕見但嚴重的免疫系統疾病，它會侵犯皮膚和黏膜；醫界對史蒂芬強森症候群的認識不多，通常有兩個比較常見的原因：一是病毒感染，例如肺炎或HIV病毒，二是藥物反應絲蟲病是一種人畜共通疾病，這種寄生蟲可能影響身體許多部位，如果進入皮膚或關節，會引發皮膚絲蟲病而導致皮膚病變關節痛和發炎；但如果絲蟲進入淋巴系，就可能導致可怕的象皮病浣熊蛔蟲症非常罕見，全世界可能不到100個病例，但這種寄生蟲會傷害大腦，大部分是難以復原的損傷，甚至死亡
